name: JK Cement Ltd
title: JK Cement Ltd - 532644 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA ₹670 cr (18.5% margin) with 2.5 mt added volume guided for FY27 and ₹10/bag price hike passed on; capacity still ramping into a competitive Central/Rajasthan market, with Jaisalmer capex ₹3,630 cr on track for H1 FY28.

utilisation.quote: CC ratio like, we were at 67%.

capex.peers_comment: Management said competition would intensify; Jaypee plant volumes expected from beginning of Q3.
capex.quote: For this year, the capex should be in the range of INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.

triggers.label: Capex FY27 ₹3,500–4,000 cr
triggers.quote: For this year, the capex should be in the range of INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.

triggers.label: ₹10/bag price hike passed on
triggers.quote: we would have on an averag e a price increase of about INR 10 a bag.

triggers.label: Incremental volume 2.5 mt in FY27
triggers.quote: we should get incremental definitely 2.5 million tons incremental volume, maybe more.

triggers.label: Jaypee 5 mt entering Central India
triggers.quote: it's only from beginning of Q3 that you should start seeing some material coming from the Jaypee plants.

triggers.label: Expanded capacity utilisation 65–75%
triggers.quote: So expanded capacity overall utilization should be around 65%, 75%, combined.
